app_purpose: server-side HTML sanitization allowlist (sanitize untrusted HTML before rendering in a Rails view)
root_cause: Mutation XSS (mXSS) via HTML4-parser (Nokogiri/libxml2) CDATA-under-<style> serialization vs browser HTML5 re-parse, in the select/style (and svg/math/style) tag combination (CWE-79)

invariant_deps.note: loofah + nokogiri are pinned IDENTICAL across v0/v1/v2 so the SOLE variable is the rails-html-sanitizer gem. loofah 2.19.1 has no Loofah.html5_mode? -> loofah_using_html5? is false -> the 1.4.3 guard's `!loofah_using_html5?` is TRUE (HTML4 parser in use), preserving the CDATA-under-<style> serialization the mXSS relies on.

sink.detail_v1_fix: allowed_tags(options): `if options[:tags] then remove_safelist_tag_combinations(options[:tags]) else self.class.allowed_tags end` -- scrub only on the :tags branch
sink.detail_v1_scrub: def remove_safelist_tag_combinations(tags): `if !loofah_using_html5? && tags.include?("select") && tags.include?("style") then warn(...); tags.delete("style") end; tags`
sink.detail_v2_fix: scrubbers.rb scrub(node): cdata branch changed from `node.replace(create_text_node(node.text))` to `if Loofah::HTML5::Scrub.cdata_needs_escaping?(node) then node.replace(Loofah::HTML5::Scrub.cdata_escape(node))`
sink.parameter: attacker-controlled HTML passed to SafeListSanitizer#sanitize and rendered into the page

poc.allowlist_override: select style svg math p b i span div a ul ol li h1 h2 h3 mi mo mn ms mtext annotation-xml -- OVERRIDES the default to include BOTH 'select' and 'style' (the CVE-2022-23520 precondition that arms the 1.4.3 select+style safelist scrub); 'img'/'script' are NOT in the allowlist.
poc.residual_api_path: SafeListSanitizer.allowed_tags = [..select..style..svg..math..]; SafeListSanitizer#sanitize(html) -- class-level override, NO :tags option (mode=class)
poc.payload_note: The original and residual use the IDENTICAL payload; ONLY the API path differs (per-call :tags vs class-level allowed_tags) -- that path difference IS the CVE-2022-23520 incomplete-fix gap. evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: GHSA-rrfc-7g8p-99q8: 'due to an incomplete fix of CVE-2022-32209 ... may allow an attacker to inject content if the application developer has overridden the sanitizer's allowed tags to allow both "select" and "style" elements.' Writeup: 'the new method remove_safelist_tag_combinations does not apply to that [class-level] list.'

audit.evidence: Live gate on real Docker (v0/v1/v2 sanitizer services + real selenium/chromium browser + victim + callback all up). Variant-A mXSS PASS passed=true: select+style payload reaches flag@v0 (rails-html-sanitizer 1.4.2, beacon to callback), blocked@v1 (1.4.3 CVE-2022-32209 fix), same-class bypass reaches flag@v1, residual@v2 probe returned empty dump (1.4.4 fix, no beacon -> blocked). Real gems installed (rails-html-sanitizer/loofah/nokogiri/crass), payload sanitized by genuine gem then rendered in real Chromium -> real-library-wrap.

provenance.notes: App runs the REAL Rails::Html::SafeListSanitizer (gem rails-html-sanitizer 1.4.2/1.4.3/1.4.4, build-arg RHS_VER) over an allowlist that overrides tags to include both select and style; loofah 2.19.1 + nokogiri 1.13.10 pinned identical across envs so only the sanitizer gem differs. Selenium headless-chromium victim proves JS execution (flag exfiltrated only via browser-side mutation of the <style> CDATA, not reflection). Genuine incomplete fix: 1.4.3 guarded only the per-call :tags path; the class-level allowed_tags override kept the same select+style mXSS alive until 1.4.4.
